verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Lovable serves a live llms.txt at docs.lovable.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled 'Lovable Documentation'), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs pages are also served as raw .md URLs, which suits agent consumption. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs usage, evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, independent corroboration of agents using it in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
